text:
lucy: Kicking off a micro-canary for v3.4.0 in eu-west - initial 8%. change window 01:50-03:20 UTC. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/rollouts/1764301111
deploy-bot: rollout started: v3.4.0 -> 8% (eu-west). cohort=c-9401
ops-oncall: watching; will report in 4m.
deploy-bot: t+3m snapshot: p50=105ms p95=205ms 5xx=0.2%
nate: saw a small p95 tail at t+7m for edge-eu5, marking here.
riya: pulling runtime logs now. snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T02:40:12Z] host=eu5-02 model=rdx-small-quant runtime_ms=460 kv_evictions=10 errors=0.6%
[2026-03-23T02:40:13Z] host=eu5-08 model=rdx-small-quant runtime_ms=520 kv_evictions=15 errors=1.0%
```
ops-oncall: kv cache churn and elevated gc pauses on quantized variant. looks correlated with tokenizer changes in release notes: https://git.redwood/release-notes/v3.4.0
lucy: request pause at 8% while we triage.
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 8% (manual by lucy). action=pause_user_lucy id=a-1102
release-manager: recommend regional pin to v3.3.9-quant-stable for eu-west cohort while we investigate, hold for 20m.
nate: queued rollback command if pin doesn't help: `/deploy rollback --service=inference --from=v3.4.0 --to=v3.3.9 --region=eu-west --reason="canary_quant_tail"`
deploy-bot: note: change window open; >10% traffic changes require window lock. current action falls within window.
ops-oncall: applying routing override now: cohort c-9401 -> v3.3.9-quant-stable (eu-west). override id=r-7012
deploy-bot: routing override applied r-7012.
riya: t+5m after pin p95 down to 175ms, 5xx 0.3%, GC back near baseline.
lucy: good improvement. propose wait 10m then continue to 20% with health gates p95<250ms and 5xx<0.6%.
release-manager: +1, will annotate release notes if we keep pin.
nate: standing by to execute rollback if metrics don't recover.
ops-oncall: continuing watch, will post any regression.
lucy: thanks all, leaving ops-oncall to monitor the next 20m. end.
